title: Que Nota
style: melodic trap, cloud rap, psychedelic trap, 154 BPM, male autotune vocals, pitched adlibs, wavy 808 slides, dark melodic pads, liquid synth arps, stereo phaser textures, granular vocal chops, sub-bass sidechain, halftime snare bounce, trap hi-hat triplets, spacious plate reverb, tape saturation, luxurious defiance, conscious pride, hook-driven anthem
lyrics:
NC Argis…
Melodic trap…
I carry the key…
[Verse 1]
But tell me what’s the vibe, don’t hit my line if you don’t really know
I’m shaudey from the gates of heaven, I carry the key, that’s for sure
God’s timing is perfect, there’s no delay in the plan
While I’m making music with real value, keep what life gives you at its best, my man
When I drop a track I never miss, from the gallera I’m your best rooster, tok tok
NC Argis in the city, I never die, you the Krilin moreno making hits and looking pretty
Defend your values and let that feeling out, no cap
Not tryna flex on you, just respect the rank
After the pargo comes a bag full of mango
The trasher pulls up, feel the weight I carry with these powers
They call me Malcolm, what’s the problem if I believe in the movie?
Grandma’s advice still echoes in the living room
Remember there’s people so fake, they only wanna see your face
[Chorus]
Que nota, que nota the confidence I radiate
Now it’s full, so you can see this rapper was made for this game
I already know what’s up, I’ve been putting in the work
Now it’s finally worth it
When I wake up in the morning, mmm just a glass of avena
Not everybody got this kind of constancia
‘Cause most of them lose their mind
Some value life, but I value building wealth
I killed all the laziness inside my body
Just to build that empire, no one else but me
Thanks to my abuela who prays for me every day
So there’s always food on the table, that’s the way
[Verse 2]
You think everything comes easy ‘cause you got a pretty face, you’re wrong
I make a rolón then I go play fútbol, when I’m bored I hit the malecón
This is another level, living in San Juan
This is my first love, I’m never letting go
When the verses explode it’s ‘cause they come from deep inside
I organize my mind, inspired by the waves and the sunset sky
They try to switch you up in one move
Acting like they’re really on
But this is trap with values, I’m not ruined
I keep my ideas under lock and key
It’s normal if I’m not registered yet
The product I’m carrying never expires, you see
Be careful with the thoughts you let in
I’m talking ‘bout my music, don’t get it twisted
When my conscience speaks, that’s who I really am
[Chorus]
Que nota, que nota the confidence I radiate
Now it’s full, so you can see this rapper was made for this game
I already know what’s up, I’ve been putting in the work
Now it’s finally worth it
[Outro]
Defend your values… let that feeling out…
I carry the key… God’s timing is perfect…
NC Argis… melodic trap with soul…
Que nota… que nota…
